result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, applies cyber coverage to Kubient’s data-processing activities, requires workers’ compensation as required by law, and provides for certificates on request. It leaves the existing general provisions unchanged. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after the Term exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored; any post-termination requirement should generally be limited to claims-made E&O and cyber coverage, if needed. Otherwise, the clause is professionally drafted.
